description: Assessment appeal application page 2: sections 5-8 and Certification are headings at the level of sections 1-4. In section 5 each DATE OF NOTICE and ROLL YEAR box is a field labelled by the caption printed before its blank line, and the blank line is not left beside it as underscores (#281). The check-box groups with exclusive choices are radios: section 5 ("Check only one") is one group of six, across its two printed rows, sections 7 and 8 are pairs. Each radio is still its own PDF field, and no fieldset has an empty legend (#281).
